high_level_description: This image is an educational infographic titled "History of the Universe," which illustrates the evolution of the universe from the Big Bang to the present day. The infographic is supported by the Particle Data Group, LBNL (Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory), and DOE (Department of Energy). Title and Source Information: The title at the top reads "HISTORY OF THE UNIVERSE." The source is credited to "Particle Data Group, LBNL © 2015" and "Supported by DOE."
